overview.about: The Hero World Challenge is an elite, limited-field invitational hosted by Tiger Woods to benefit his foundation, played each December at the Albany resort in the Bahamas. With around 20 of the world's best players and no cut, it is a relaxed but high-quality end-of-season event. Tiger Woods himself has won it five times. The 2026 edition is on 3-7 December.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Hero World Challenge runs 3-7 December at Albany, New Providence, in the Bahamas. It is an unofficial event - it does not carry official PGA Tour win status - but it awards world-ranking points and draws a top-class field.
